events.title: Laws of Nadragia demo is in Next Fest!
events.summary: I'm finally taking part in Steam Next Fest with my game, Laws of Nadragia, as I prepare for its release next year! You can only participate in Next Fest once, so I'm really nervous >

events.title: Development Update – Getting Closer to Release
events.summary: I've finally decided to write a development update about how things are going with my detective prosecutor simulator set in the totalitarian medieval state of Nadragia. events.title: A new dynamic trailer!
events.summary: The Supreme Collegium is proud to present a new dynamic trailer for The Laws of Nadragia!In the first trailer, we tried to introduce people to our characters. In the new second trailer, we've used a more dynamic approach to what's happening and shown some new interfaces and animations of the characters that will be in the game.Write in the comments, did you like it? We are eager to know your opinion! ːsteamhappyː

events.title: Major update of the demo version: Voice acting, animations, bugs
events.summary: Dear ladies and gentlemen, members of the Supreme Collegium! I have amazing news for you: The Laws of Nadragia will have partial character voiceover! Yes-yes, you heard it right: Each character now has a large set of lines and emotions to accompany his speech. For this, 9 different speakers in Russian and English were involved in order to show the character and mood of the characters as amazingly and authentically as possible. Will Aiden be able to survive at his post? What tricks will he use to achieve a quota of guilty verdicts? It is for you to decide!
